description: Sabotages for durable-ioring-events. Run with tools/run-sabotage.ps1; see tools/README-sabotage.md for the format and for why the results are read the way they are.
notCoveredHere: What only a trace session can show is not swept here: that the sink wants a kind only when a session listens to it, that the level and keyword filters hold, and that each event reaches a session as its values are tests/session.rs, which are ignored without elevation (DE-D-4), so a sweep on a machine that cannot start a session would report a sabotage of those as surviving for a reason that is not a hole. That the manifest decodes is checked by hand with mc, rc, wevtutil and tracerpt (DE-D-3).

sabotages.name: DE-D-1: the provider's GUID is changed
sabotages.why: A GUID is what a session enables the provider by; changing it breaks every session that enabled it, so it is pinned.

sabotages.name: DE-D-2: the lock wait's id is changed
sabotages.why: A reader decodes by an event's id, so each is pinned, and none may share another's.

sabotages.name: DE-D-2: two keywords share a bit
sabotages.why: A session filters by keyword bits, so a bit shared by two categories enables both together.

sabotages.name: DE-D-2: a lock wait is written with no time
sabotages.why: The time a wait took is the event's whole purpose.

sabotages.name: DE-D-2: a domain's length is written as zero
sabotages.why: The length is what a reader takes the domain's bytes by, so a length that does not match them misreads every field after.

sabotages.name: DE-D-2: whether a flush succeeded is reported backwards
sabotages.why: A failed flush reported as a success hides the failure the event exists to show.

sabotages.name: DE-D-2: text is cut to its first unit
sabotages.why: A name or a detail written as one unit is no name.

sabotages.name: DE-D-3: the manifest names an error as a warning
sabotages.why: The manifest is rendered from the table, and a level it names wrong disagrees with the descriptor the sink writes.

sabotages.name: DE-D-4: an event is built though no session is listening to it
sabotages.why: A sink that does not check the event itself before building it formats text for an event no one wants: the cost the sink exists to avoid.

sabotages.name: DE-D-4: each sink registers the provider of its own
sabotages.why: The page asks that a component register one or two providers; a registration for each sink would use a process's up.

sabotages.name: DE-D-2 control: a count is converted by another spelling that gives the same value
sabotages.why: A control: the same value by another spelling, which no test can tell apart. A sweep that reports it caught is reporting everything caught and proves nothing.
find: let count = |n: usize| Value::UInt64(n as u64);
